title: 第一卷 第22章 吞噬我，成为神明！
novel_title: 开局自曝系统，家族助我娶妻成仙！
content_zh:
接引台，是阎浮大世界连接下方世界的通道，在五域之中，各有一座。

    姜家位于东域，在接引台附近，早已聚集了不少人。

    “拜见帝子，拜见六长老！”

    见姜无痕几人到来，众人纷纷跪拜。

    “都起来吧！”

    姜清濯挥手，祭出了准帝兵级别的炎阳仙舟，横亘在接引台上方。

    “此番前往创生莲华界，一切以守护帝子安危为重！”姜清濯看向众人，话语中透露出威严，“出发！”

    一声令下，众人纷纷踏上炎阳仙舟。

    姜凡、姜怜、姜凌尘、姜纤纤四位圣体，来到了姜无痕面前。

    以姜凡为首，躬身行礼：“帝子，家主安排我等四人贴身保护帝子安危，属下愿竭尽心力，为帝子效死！”

    “为帝子效死！”

    其他三人点头附和。

    姜清濯站在一旁，看着几人神情肃穆的模样，淡然道：“不必紧张，以你们几个如今的战力，随便拎出一个，都能给创生莲华界造成灭世级的毁灭！”

    “此番为确保万无一失，家主让我带上了恒御大帝的证道帝兵……”

    言语间，她祭出了万欲神炉。

    这一次，除了这位携极道帝兵的大圣巅峰强者，还有雪姨这位圣人王，以及二十几位圣人，八十多位劫境尊者。

    再加上四位圣体级的贴身护卫……

    知道的他们是去接人，不知道的，还以为是要去灭世呢！

    这阵仗，虽说有些夸张，但在姜家高层眼里，帝子的安危重于一切！

    如果不是创生莲华界最多只能抗住大圣强者降临，姜无痕出这趟远门，他们非得把镇守生命禁区的恒御大帝摇回来，给姜无痕充当侍卫！

    就在这时，姜无痕在人群中看到了一道熟悉的小身影。

    “沐凝薇！”

    姜无痕上前，将她从人群里揪了出来。

    “嘻嘻，爹爹……”

    沐凝薇像是个犯了错被抓住的孩子，脸上挂着尴尬的笑容。

    姜无痕看向雪姨，无奈道：“她怎么在这？”

    “帝子，我……”

    雪姨面露难色，她今天并没有带沐凝薇修炼，也不清楚这丫头是怎么混上来的？

    这时，姜纤纤解释道：“小叔，是我带凝薇来的……”

    “这两天，她住在我那边，随时与我切磋。方才得到家主传讯，要去下方小世界，我就把她带上了……”

    姜纤纤并不觉得有什么风险，而且，也正好让沐凝薇见见世面。

    然而，姜无痕的脸色却沉了下来：“跟你说过多少遍了，在家族外要称职务！”

    “是，帝子！”

    姜纤纤低下头，不敢直视姜无痕。

    虽说此行并无风险，但带着沐凝薇，总感觉有些怪怪的。

    “算了，无痕，来都来了，就当是让这丫头长长见识了。”

    姜清濯劝道。
content_en:
The reception platform is the passage between the great world of Jambudvipa and the world below. There is one in each of the five realms.

    The Jiang family is located in the Eastern Region, and a lot of people have already gathered near the reception platform.

    "Greetings to the Emperor and the Sixth Elder!"

    Seeing Jiang Wuhen and others arriving, everyone knelt down and worshiped.

    "Everyone get up!"

    Jiang Qingzhuo waved his hand and launched the Yanyang Immortal Boat, which was at the level of a quasi-emperor soldier, and placed it across the top of the reception platform.

    "This time we go to the Creation Lotus Realm, our top priority is to protect the safety of the emperor!" Jiang Qingzhuo looked at the crowd, his words revealed his majesty, "Let's go!"

    With an order, everyone stepped onto the Yanyang Immortal Boat.

    The four holy bodies, Jiang Fan, Jiang Lian, Jiang Lingchen, and Jiang Xianxian, came to Jiang Wuhen.

    With Jiang Fan as the leader, he bowed and saluted: "Emperor, the master of the house has arranged for four of us to personally protect the emperor's safety. I am willing to do my best to die for the emperor!"

    "Death for the emperor!"

    The other three nodded in agreement.

    Jiang Qingzhuo stood aside, looking at the solemn expressions of several people, and said calmly: "Don't be nervous, with your current combat power, just one of you can cause world-destroying destruction to the Creation Lotus Realm!"

    "To ensure nothing goes wrong this time, the head of the family asked me to bring Emperor Hengyu's Dao-proving Emperor's soldiers with me..."

    As she spoke, she sacrificed the Divine Furnace of All Desires.

    This time, in addition to the peak-level Great Sage who carries the Ji Dao Imperial Arms, there is also Aunt Xue, the Sage King, as well as more than 20 saints and more than 80 Tribulation Realm venerables.

    Plus four holy body-level personal guards...

    Those who knew they were going to pick people up, but those who didn’t know, thought they were going to destroy the world!

    Although this battle is a bit exaggerated, in the eyes of the Jiang family's senior officials, the safety of the emperor's son is more important than anything else!

    If the Lotus Realm of Creation had not been able to withstand the arrival of the powerful Great Sage at best, and Jiang Wuhen made this far journey, they would have to bring back Emperor Hengyu, who was guarding the restricted area of ​​life, and serve as Jiang Wuhen's bodyguard!

    At this moment, Jiang Wuhen saw a familiar little figure in the crowd.

    "Mu Ningwei!"

    Jiang Wuhen stepped forward and pulled her out from the crowd.

    "Hehe, daddy..."

    Mu Ningwei looked like a child who had made a mistake and was caught, with an awkward smile on her face.

    Jiang Wuhen looked at Aunt Xue and said helplessly: "Why is she here?"

    "Emperor, I..."

    Aunt Xue looked troubled. She didn't take Mu Ningwei to practice today, and she didn't know how this girl got into it.

    At this time, Jiang Xianxian explained: "Uncle, I brought Ningwei here..."

    "She has been staying at my place for the past two days, and she has been discussing with me at any time. I just received a message from the head of the family that she was going to the small world below, so I took her with me..."

    Jiang Xianxian didn't think there was any risk, and it was just a good time for Mu Ningwei to see the world.

    However, Jiang Wuhen's face darkened: "How many times have I told you that you must hold your position outside the family!"

    "Yes, Emperor's son!"

    Jiang Xianxian lowered her head, not daring to look directly at Jiang Wuhen.

    Although there is no risk in this trip, it still feels a bit strange to take Mu Ningwei with me.

    "Forget it, Wuhen, now that you're here, let's just treat this girl as a long-term experience."

    Jiang Qingzhuo advised.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 22 Devour me and become a god!
